test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: RSTR is related to UVWU in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, WXYW is related to ZABZ. To which of the given options is FGHF related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is,

Each letter shifts **+3** positions forward in the English alphabetical order.

**For 'RSTR' related to 'UVWU':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a80c802091170429d2f4e599774e209ee83fd4809af551587ed8a9c36e25d345.png] 

**For 'WXYW' related to 'ZABZ':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc3208c2b966dc422f02535bf894e6eb99ec40b2ce82bc7a38f37b7ea4d38bae.png] 

The consistent pattern observed is: **+3, +3, +3, +3** for each letter position.

**Applying the same logic to 'FGHF':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31c1011cb58cfee905912d0eac9d36545ec7c3cbb28254566f7fe35dce4ae103.png] 

Thus, 'FGHF' will be coded as **IJKI**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
